reviewed_releases.date_note: Named as a previously used client in the 2.12 upgrade notice; no release day is established.
research_notes: The 2.12 notice directly names 2.10 and 2.11 clients as predecessors. This proves the labels, not their release dates or particular changes.

reviewed_releases.date_note: Named as a previously used client in the 2.12 upgrade notice; no release day is established.
research_notes: The 2.12 notice directly names 2.10 and 2.11 clients as predecessors. This proves the labels, not their release dates or particular changes.

reviewed_releases.date_note: The body explicitly reports an upgrade on 12/04. The year is contextual, from the publisher's dated 19981204.html source path; it is not printed in the surviving body. The archive capture date is not the release date.
notes: Adds an option to switch the animated torch effects in the Kasmanium mine on or off.
Adds data for four fifth-circle monsters, five fifth-circle outfits, two Christmas-event outfits and a New Year card.
Adds Push, a second-circle rogue skill.
Removes login loading, improves speed and fixes screen redraw problems under the named status effects.
research_notes: The original map-view paragraph and spell/skill "세이" wording are preserved in the capture; their precise UI/command meaning is not resolved here. Do not silently translate "세이" as a particular spoken or save command.

The patch instructions name 2.10/2.11 as predecessor versions. A later automatic-update sentence reads 2.10/2.12; preserve this source inconsistency instead of treating it as proof of a separate release.

reviewed_releases.date_note: The notice is dated 99.02.23 and explicitly schedules the upgrade for 99/02/23; actual deployment time was not independently observed.
notes: Adds distributed-server support, a friends list, guild-member markers in the user list and character legends.
Adds conversation mode and chat in the exchange window; places user configuration files in a separate folder.
Adds waiting-room maps for the catacombs and Piet dungeon, event-item data and a client notice screen; fixes minor bugs.
research_notes: The notice says automatic updating was unavailable for this release; it offered a full client or manual patch. This is distribution evidence, not a recovered download or installer identity.

reviewed_releases.date_note: The publisher's notice is dated 1999-02-26 and describes version 2.15 in operation; it does not explicitly establish the release day.
notes: The version notice describes a four-component distributed-server arrangement: login, towns and two dungeon servers, expanded from three components.
research_notes: The body explains that whispers cannot cross component servers and transfers can take time. It is a dated operation report, not an explicit statement that 2.15 launched on its publication day.
This Korean 2.15 is independent of the catalog's U.S. closed-beta 2.15. Do not merge them across regions.

reviewed_releases.date_note: The publisher's notice is dated 1999-04-30 and discusses the 2.16 version; no explicit release-day statement survives.
notes: Improves internal optimization and stability.
research_notes: The captured source retains an explicit :80 in its replay URL and was successfully retrieved. Do not replace its capture timestamp with a guessed release date.

reviewed_releases.date_note: The December 13, 1999 update notice schedules the patch only for "this week"; the older dated HTML says "next week". No exact release day is established.
notes: Preparatory update for third-circle outfit animation fixes, monster fixes, nationality display, pathfinding and automatic-attack fixes, and moving the speed indicator.
Prepares Christmas/snow-event assets, skiing clothes, pet dogs, penguin outfits and 20 new hairstyles for each sex.
Prepares equipment data, fourfold expansions of Mileth, Abel and Rucesion, and a mine reset; the publisher warns that most visible changes would arrive later.
research_notes: The December 13 date is the ASP registration date, not the release date. The older 19991209-1.html copy has an earlier relative schedule; neither supplies a day.
Do not present all prepared content as having gone live with the client update.

reviewed_releases.date_note: The December 28, 1999 notice explicitly schedules 3.04 after regular maintenance on December 29; actual deployment was not independently observed.
notes: Prepares Millennium and hair-event content, fourth-circle colored event outfits, weather effects, monsters, merchants and a new dungeon form.
Fixes a display bug, prepares a threefold mine expansion and two Mileth dungeons; some event clothing and weapons were to become available later.
research_notes: The publisher calls this a data-file patch. The Town of Death event dungeon was to open during the event, with a full opening planned for late January 2000; this is not evidence that every staged feature was available December 29.

reviewed_releases.date_note: The body schedules 3.10 for January 25 at 10:00 a.m. The year is contextual, from the publisher's dated 20000124.html source path and a March 2000 capture; it is not printed in the surviving body. Actual deployment was not independently observed.
notes: Adds multi-server operation for the Seo, Khan and Hades books/servers.
Adds data for new warrior skills, whose activation was planned later that week after the multi-server system stabilized.
research_notes: The notice requires a new full client and says neither automatic nor manual patching would work. No corresponding package was recovered in this research.
The shared notice names Hades among server destinations. This alone does not establish a separately numbered Hades executable or beta package.

reviewed_releases.date_note: The notice is registered March 7, 2000 and explicitly schedules the patch for March 7 at 10:00 a.m.; actual deployment was not independently observed.
notes: Adds rogue traps and fifth-circle outfit variants.
Adds official-guild castles, outfits and weapons.
Adds the first 30-floor Town of Death underground dungeon for fifth-circle characters, plus monsters for the town interiors and underground areas.
research_notes: Enrich the existing Korean production 3.11 record; do not create a duplicate. The preserved CD clients independently identify version 311, but this notice does not establish that either recovered installer is the exact March 7 package.

reviewed_releases.date_note: The June 12, 2000 retrospective explicitly says the 3.50 patch occurred on May 2. A May 2 notice uses 3.5/3,5 for matching content; June 12 is not the release date.
notes: Prepares advancement outfits, class weapons, hats, skill/spell effects and related data.
Adds Town of Death floors 31–50, including a town-like floor 31, recall-making materials from floors 32–50, maze areas and monsters.
Prepares May customer-event items including sea, flame, earth and wind pendants. Advancement/class-change activation was planned for mid-May after the data patch.
research_notes: Treat 3.5 and 3,5 in the May 2 source as source spellings for this 3.50 patch, not three releases: the later body explicitly names May 2 and repeats the same content.
The source distinguishes preparation data from the later gameplay activation; do not date advancement/class-change availability solely from this client release.

reviewed_releases.date_note: Two notices registered June 19, 2000 explicitly schedule 3.6 for the morning of Tuesday, June 20; actual deployment was not independently observed.
notes: Prepares Red Dragon Cave advancement-dungeon data, monsters, effects, skills/spells and monster behavior patterns.
Adds a beginner-school area, formation-spell effects, speed improvements and graphics fixes. Advancement/class-change activation was scheduled for the last week of June after the data patch.
research_notes: The publisher prints 3.6. This research preserves that spelling and does not invent a separate 3.60 release.
Later 3.61 text still plans the Red Dragon Cave opening in August; preserve the distinction between shipped data and a later opening.

reviewed_releases.date_note: The July 31, 2000 notice twice schedules 3.61 for the morning of August 1; actual deployment was not independently observed.
notes: Adds advancement martial-artist weapon data, pending advancement skill/spell effects and icons, and adjustments to advancement clothing for class changes.
Adds Red Dragon Cave glove, greave, necklace and belt data.
Prepares summer undersea-event swimsuits, oxygen tanks, flippers and maps, and reworks honeymoon destinations. The summer dungeon was planned for early August and Red Dragon Cave for later in August.
research_notes: The source distinguishes the August 1 client patch from later dungeon openings; the dates of those openings were not independently recovered here.

reviewed_releases.date_note: The surviving body explicitly schedules 4.2 for March 13 in the morning, while its registration header says January 24, 2001. The schedule is retained with that mismatch disclosed; actual deployment was not independently observed.
notes: Removes accumulated snow and adds yellow spring training outfits and event clothing.
Adds Omok and football minigame areas, advancement skill/spell-quest dungeon data, and warrior advancement helmets; improves martial-artist advancement-headband graphics.
The notice says full application would take about a week after the patch.
research_notes: The body apologizes for a delayed patch. The January 24 header and March 13 body schedule are preserved, not silently reconciled into a January 24 release.
The publisher prints 4.2; this research does not invent a distinct 4.20 package identity.
